title: `E0303` for a class no `autoload` root has names no root it searched.
text: A program that names a class its `autoload` roots cannot load gets `E0303`, and the message names none of the roots. The reader is not told which roots were searched, so a wrong root in `nvs.toml` looks the same as a typo in the class name. It closes when `E0303` lists the roots it searched for the class, with a case that pins the text.
